name: en-tool-calling
description: The agent round-trip in en: the model is offered a function, asks for it, the harness feeds the result back as a tool message, and later turns are graded on whether that result was used. Calls are checked by parsing rather than executing, the proxy BFCL validated. tools[].function.strict is omitted — the gateway silently strips it on the Kimi route.

turns.say: What is the weather in Prague right now? Use the tool available to you.
Given that result, what is the temperature in Celsius? Reply with the number only.
Now convert that same temperature to Fahrenheit. Reply with the number only.
Reply with JSON only: an object with keys "city" and "condition", taken from the tool result you received.
Which city did you look up? Reply with the name only.
